summary: Preserve an agent-facing file index command that generates known-files maps from Figma project/team metadata without indexing stale node trees.
reason: Agents need to resolve human file names to file keys across large teams; the durable behavior is read-only project/team listing plus a strictly additive local known-files merge that preserves operator notes.
validated_outcome: go test ./internal/cli passes with fake project/team servers covering project indexing, team walks, alias collisions, and additive --merge-into behavior.
